description: One composition record (Part 4): the parts of a composite object and how they are driven. Two emitters share this schema. The atlas side (nar-atlas, from frame-name grouping) always sets a classification (labelled inferred), driver 'unknown' with a driver_reason, empty attachment_points and low confidence, because an atlas carries no driver data. The animation side (nar-anim) sets the driver (skeletal, physics, sprite-swap or shader) from driver evidence and may leave classification null when the object's kind is not determinable.
title: NAR composition record (Part 4)
